# Desert Grey Music Festival

> A one-day alternative rock festival in the Sonoran desert. Acoustic, fuzz, post-punk, doom & everything between — 25+ bands across three stages at the Nile Theater in downtown Mesa, Arizona.

## Event details

- **Date:** Saturday, October 3, 2026
- **Doors:** 2:00 PM
- **Last set:** 1:00 AM
- **Venue:** Nile Theater, 105 W Main St., Mesa, AZ 85201
- **Capacity:** 2,400
- **Stages:** Three (main hall, underground, coffee shop)
- **Ages:** All-ages, 21+ bar
- **Edition:** Vol. 04 · MMXXVI

## Lineup highlights

**Headliners:** Sorry X, No Halos, Emerald Isle.

**Main bill:** Arsenic Kitchen, Those Kind Of People, An Awful Mess, Diva Bleach, rio wiley, Mattstagraham, Phantom Spring, Something Outrageous, Perfect Sense.

**Support:** GNUMB, SLOWBVRN, HOMETURF, SUNDRESSED, KILLED BY YETI, DANNY SILVERTONE, DEATH DOT GOV, PHAGE, I AM ANYTHING, THE BLISSINS, ANGELA DRIVE, DOUBLESPEAK, CHRIS CRAWFORD, YESTERDAYSOUP, CHRIS CRIMMINS.

## Tickets

- **Single Day:** $48 (general admission, all three stages, re-entry until 10pm)
- **Inner Circle:** $95 (mezzanine, private bar, early entry, commemorative poster)
- **Crew Pass:** $320 (four wristbands, dedicated group entry, shared locker)

Checkout runs on PurplePass. Payment plans via Klarna or Affirm. Tickets transferable until 10 days before the festival. No refunds.
